catalano.gallery: all distinct #product-gallery images + exact code previewSrc when available

recorFeetVisuals.behavior: visual chooser for mandatory feet; local images are style references and are included with selected foot in client dossier

recorImagesV1119.priority: exact Recor product page + WooCommerce full-resolution gallery anchors/data-large_image

recorImagesV1119.clientDossier: bath dominant; selected feet as small visual; waste text-only
recorImagesV1119.pixelGuard: when dimensions are measurable: max side >= 800 px and min side >= 500 px; otherwise reject thumbnail result

notes: Automatic manufacturer imagery: Nicolazzi/Ritmonio shared base cache, exact Nicolazzi WooCommerce gallery extraction, viewport hydration, 6-hour server page cache and in-flight request deduplication to accelerate Zucchetti.

recorTechnicalPdfV1122.productPageSession: open exact Recor product page first and reuse set-cookie session
recorTechnicalPdfV1122.liveDrawingUrl: refresh Technical drawing PDF href from official product page
recorTechnicalPdfV1122.validation: require real %PDF signature before pdf.js rendering
recorTechnicalPdfV1122.clientDossier: pass exact Recor product page URL to PDF renderer

ritmonio.visualRule: use official product photo with finish swatch badge when finish-specific photography is unavailable
ritmonio.deduplication: 20,378 tariff lines consolidated to unique article references; compatibleCollections retained
ritmonio.offline: 18 finish assets in service worker shell

nicolazzi.visualRule: official product image + exact Nicolazzi finish swatch when finish-specific photography is unavailable

gessi.visualRule: finish-specific official photo when available; otherwise official product photo + exact Gessi finish swatch

githubDeployment.reason: Avoid browser/GitHub upload limits while preserving all catalog rows and finish visuals.

gessiImageFix.fallback: no corporate OG/logo image; retain finish swatch presentation if exact remote image is unavailable
